label: Actuator
summary: An output device that converts electrical control signals into physical movement, force, or mechanical displacement.
plain_descriptions: mechanism that converts electrical control commands into physical motion
component that moves or controls a physical mechanism in response to a signal

label: Impression
summary: A metric recording each individual occurrence of an advertisement being fetched and rendered on a user's viewport screen.
plain_descriptions: every single time an advertisement appears on someone's screen
the total view count of an ad including repeat sightings by the same person

label: Agent
summary: An autonomous AI system that reasons over objectives, breaks goals into sequential steps, and interacts with tools and environments to complete tasks.
plain_descriptions: an AI system that plans steps and uses tools to achieve goals independently
a software assistant that observes its environment, takes actions, and completes tasks

label: Algorithm
summary: A well-defined, finite sequence of unambiguous instructions designed to perform a specific computational computation or solve a problem.
plain_descriptions: unambiguous, step-by-step recipe of instructions designed to solve a specific problem
computational formula that processes input data and produces a deterministic output

label: Application Programming Interface (API)
summary: A set of defined rules, protocols, and endpoints enabling different software applications to communicate and exchange data.
plain_descriptions: a defined bridge that allows two software systems to talk to each other
a digital waiter taking requests from one application to another

label: Endpoint
summary: A dedicated network address and URL path exposed by an API where clients access a specific service or resource.
plain_descriptions: the specific web address where an app sends requests to get certain information
a digital front door where external software asks a server to do something

label: Arduino
summary: An open-source electronics prototyping platform encompassing programmable microcontroller hardware boards and a simplified software development environment for controlling physical actuators and sensors.
plain_descriptions: open-source microcontroller board and software platform for controlling physical electronics
easy-to-program electronic prototyping board that reads buttons and turns on motors

label: Array
summary: A linear data structure consisting of a collection of elements identified by index or key, stored in contiguous memory locations.
plain_descriptions: ordered collection of elements stored at contiguous memory locations accessed by zero-based indices
basic sequence list where each item is identified by its numerical position

label: Aspect ratio
summary: The proportional ratio describing the relationship of an image, frame, or display device's width relative to its height.
plain_descriptions: the proportional relationship between the width and height of an image or screen
screen dimension proportion such as 16:9 widescreen or 9:16 vertical smartphone format

label: Asset
summary: A present economic resource controlled by an entity as a result of past events from which future economic benefits are expected to flow.
plain_descriptions: anything of economic value owned or controlled by a person or company
valuable resource expected to generate future financial benefits or cash

label: Reach
summary: The total number of distinct, unduplicated individuals or user accounts exposed to a piece of media content or advertisement during a specified period.
plain_descriptions: the number of unique individual people who see your content or ad
how many different people your message successfully touches

label: B-roll
summary: Supplemental video footage spliced alongside primary interview or action shots to illustrate topics, hide edit splices, and enrich storytelling.
plain_descriptions: secondary video footage cut into a scene to visually support the primary interview or narrative
background and illustrative camera shots used in film editing to cover cuts and enhance context

label: Balance sheet
summary: A core financial statement summarizing an entity’s assets, liabilities, and shareholders’ equity at a specific point in time.
plain_descriptions: financial snapshot showing what a business owns and owes at one moment
document balancing company assets against debts and owner equity

label: Bank transfer
summary: An electronic transfer of funds from one bank account to another across an interbank clearing and settlement network.
plain_descriptions: electronic moving of money from one bank account directly into another
digital payment sent between bank accounts without physical cash or paper checks

label: Binary search
summary: An efficient search algorithm that finds the position of a target value within a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search interval.
plain_descriptions: fast search algorithm that finds an item in a sorted list by repeatedly dividing the search range in half
lookup technique that compares target values against the middle element of an ordered array

label: Bond
summary: A fixed-income debt instrument issued by governments or corporations that pays periodic interest to bondholders and repays principal at maturity.
plain_descriptions: loan you make to a government or corporation that pays you fixed interest and returns your money at maturity
fixed-income investment where an issuer promises regular interest payments and full principal repayment

label: Breaking news
summary: Newly received information about an urgent, ongoing event that warrants immediate public dissemination across news outlets.
plain_descriptions: real-time reports on urgent events developing as we speak
immediate media updates about sudden occurrences of high public interest

label: Breakpoint
summary: An intentional stopping point configured in source code or instruction addresses where a debugger suspends execution to allow state inspection.
plain_descriptions: intentional pause point placed in code that halts program execution so developers can inspect state
marker set on a specific line of source code where a debugger suspends the running thread

label: Browser cache
summary: A temporary storage mechanism within a web browser that retains previously fetched HTTP resources to speed up future requests.
plain_descriptions: a temporary storage folder where your browser saves images and files to reload sites faster
local memory holding downloaded web assets to avoid requesting them repeatedly

label: Budget
summary: An itemised financial plan that estimates anticipated income and allocates it toward expenses, savings, and debt payoff over a set period.
plain_descriptions: plan for how much money to spend and save each month
roadmap tracking incoming paychecks against upcoming bills

label: Byline
summary: A line in a publication identifying the writer or contributor responsible for the reporting and prose of an article.
plain_descriptions: the line crediting the reporter who investigated and wrote the piece
attribution stating who authored a printed or online article

label: Cache
summary: A high-speed data storage layer that stores a subset of transient data so future requests are served faster than accessing primary storage.
plain_descriptions: a fast temporary storage area saving frequent answers so the computer skips slow re-calculations
keeping copies of popular web pages in memory so users don't wait for slow database queries

label: Call to action (CTA)
summary: A marketing prompt, button, or statement designed to encourage immediate user response and guide prospects toward a desired action.
plain_descriptions: a prompt or button telling a visitor exactly what step to take next
the direct invitation urging people to buy, sign up, or click now

label: Cash flow statement
summary: A financial statement tracking the aggregate inflows and outflows of actual cash across operating, investing, and financing operations.
plain_descriptions: document tracking hard currency entering and leaving corporate bank accounts
financial report breaking down cash changes into operating, investing, and financing

label: CI/CD
summary: A modern engineering methodology uniting frequent source integration with automated regression testing and reliable application deployment.
plain_descriptions: automatically building, testing, and shipping code changes whenever engineers push work
the automated pipeline that moves software from development to live production servers

label: Class
summary: An extensible code template that defines the state properties and callable behaviors for constructing objects.
plain_descriptions: architectural template for manufacturing objects with shared attributes and behaviors
code blueprint specifying what variables and methods an instantiated entity will possess

label: Content management system (CMS)
summary: Software that lets editors create, format, publish, and organize digital content on the web without editing source code directly.
plain_descriptions: website platform for writing and publishing articles without code
admin dashboard where editors manage web pages and media assets

label: Code review
summary: A collaborative peer-review practice where software engineers systematically examine proposed code changes to identify defects, enforce architectural standards, and share knowledge.
plain_descriptions: having teammate developers examine your code changes before merging
a peer inspection of source code to catch bugs and uphold standards

label: Compiler
summary: A computer program that translates software source code written in a high-level programming language into machine code or an intermediate representation prior to execution.
plain_descriptions: tool that translates entire source code files into machine code or bytecode before execution
program that analyzes human-readable code and converts it into a runnable standalone binary

label: Compound Interest
summary: Interest calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods.
plain_descriptions: interest on interest
money snowballing because earnings get added back to the pile

label: Content marketing
summary: A strategic marketing approach focused on creating and distributing valuable, relevant, and consistent content to attract and retain a clearly defined audience.
plain_descriptions: creating helpful articles, videos, and guides to attract and keep customers
marketing by teaching and entertaining people rather than just pitching products

label: Context window
summary: The maximum amount of text, counted in tokens, that a model considers in one request, covering the prompt, the conversation so far and its reply.
plain_descriptions: how much text the AI can keep in mind at once
the AI’s working memory limit

label: Cookie
summary: A small piece of data stored on the user's browser by websites to retain state and track browsing activity.
plain_descriptions: small browser file websites save to remember your login
web tracker banner you click accept on

label: Copyright
summary: A form of intellectual property law protecting original works of authorship fixed in any tangible medium of expression from unauthorized copying and distribution.
plain_descriptions: the legal right giving creators exclusive control over how their works are copied and shared
intellectual property protection preventing unauthorized reproduction of original creative works

label: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
summary: A statistical index measuring the weighted average change over time in prices paid by households for a representative basket of consumer goods and services.
plain_descriptions: statistical basket tracking price changes for everyday goods bought by households
standard economic benchmark measuring the cost of living fluctuations

label: Creative Commons
summary: A nonprofit organization and legal framework providing standardized copyright licenses that permit free public distribution and remixing of creative works under specified conditions.
plain_descriptions: standardized public licenses enabling creators to share works with flexible permissions
open copyright framework allowing free cultural reuse while reserving specific conditions

label: Credit card
summary: A payment card issued by a financial institution that enables cardholders to borrow funds up to an approved limit to make purchases or cash advances.
plain_descriptions: payment card that lets you buy things on credit up to a preset limit
plastic card allowing you to borrow money from a bank for purchases and pay later

label: Credit score
summary: A numerical assessment calculated from credit history that indicates an individual's creditworthiness and likelihood of repaying debt obligations on time.
plain_descriptions: three-digit number showing lenders the probability of repaying borrowed money on time
personal financial grade determining whether you get approved for loans and credit cards

label: Customer relationship management (CRM)
summary: A business system that organizes customer details, communications, and sales opportunities in one shared workspace.
plain_descriptions: software that tracks customer interactions and deals
a shared database where sales and support log conversations

label: CSS
summary: A declarative styling language for rendering visual layout, typographic formatting, and color palettes on markup documents.
plain_descriptions: the code rules that control colors, fonts, and layouts on a website
the styling stylesheet language that makes web pages visually appealing

label: Daily active users (DAU)
summary: The total count of unique individuals who initiate a meaningful interaction with a software application within a 24-hour day.
plain_descriptions: count of unique people who open and interact with an application in a single day
vital metric tracking daily user volume and ongoing product engagement

label: Daily Scrum
summary: A 15-minute daily inspect-and-adapt event for developers to synchronize activities and plan the next 24 hours of work.
plain_descriptions: quick fifteen-minute daily morning meeting for developers to sync on sprint progress
brief stand-up check-in where teammates share achievements, plans, and immediate blockers

label: Data structure
summary: A specialized format for organizing, processing, retrieving, and storing data efficiently within computer systems.
plain_descriptions: organized layout for storing and managing information efficiently in computer memory
specialized format for grouping data items to optimize search, insertion, and retrieval operations

label: Data visualization
summary: The practice of representing quantitative data graphically through charts, maps, and visual plots to communicate insights clearly.
plain_descriptions: turning raw numbers into charts and graphs that people can understand
visual displays like heatmaps and line plots that show trends in data

label: Dataset
summary: A structured collection of data records, features, and targets partitioned to train, validate, and benchmark algorithms.
plain_descriptions: a structured collection of examples used to teach or test AI
the organized data gathered together for machine learning experiments

label: Debugging
summary: The systematic engineering process of detecting, isolating, and rectifying software defects or anomalies.
plain_descriptions: investigative process of identifying, reproducing, and fixing defects in software
methodical workflow of diagnosing anomalous behavior using logs, assertions, and stepping tools

label: Deep learning
summary: A specialized subset of machine learning utilizing multi-layered neural networks to extract hierarchical feature representations directly from complex data.
plain_descriptions: machine learning powered by deep neural networks with many hidden layers
advanced AI techniques that automatically learn rich representations from raw data

label: Deflation
summary: A persistent and widespread decline in the general price level of goods and services across an economy.
plain_descriptions: ongoing drop in general retail prices across an entire economy
economic condition where goods get cheaper but debts become harder to repay

label: Digital transformation
summary: The strategic and cultural integration of digital technology across all areas of an organization to fundamentally modernize operations and deliver customer value.
plain_descriptions: rewiring an entire business to operate using modern software and cloud tools
replacing paper forms and outdated legacy routines with digital services

label: Distributed system
summary: A system whose hardware and software components communicate and coordinate their actions over a network, presenting themselves to end users as a unified cohesive computing facility.
plain_descriptions: collection of independent computers working together appearing as a single system
software spread across multiple networked machines communicating to accomplish a task

label: Diversification
summary: A risk-management technique that mixes a wide variety of investments within a portfolio to reduce unsystematic risk.
plain_descriptions: spreading your investment money across many different assets so a loss in one will not wipe you out
the practice of not putting all your eggs into a single investment basket

label: Domain Name System (DNS)
summary: The hierarchical, decentralized naming system that translates human-readable domain names into numerical IP addresses for network routing.
plain_descriptions: the internet phonebook that translates human-friendly website names like example.com into computer IP addresses
the directory service connecting domain names to web server numbers

label: Docker
summary: An open commercial platform providing tooling to build, share, package, and execute application containers using host operating system virtualization.
plain_descriptions: the most popular software tool for building, running, and managing containers
the platform that popularised container packaging for modern software development

label: Document Object Model (DOM)
summary: A cross-platform, language-independent programming interface that treats an HTML or XML document as a tree structure of nodes.
plain_descriptions: the internal tree structure of a webpage that scripts can read and change
the programming interface representing webpage elements as interactive objects

label: Double-entry bookkeeping
summary: The universal bookkeeping method wherein every economic transaction is recorded in at least two separate ledger accounts with offsetting debit and credit entries.
plain_descriptions: accounting rule requiring every single financial transaction to be recorded in at least two accounts
system matching debits against credits to keep financial balance sheets in equilibrium

label: E-commerce platform
summary: A comprehensive software suite that enables businesses to build online stores, showcase product catalogs, manage shopping carts, and fulfill digital orders.
plain_descriptions: software engine that runs web stores with shopping carts and inventory
online storefront software where merchants list items and process orders

label: E-wallet
summary: An electronic application or device that securely stores digital payment credentials and funds to facilitate online, in-app, and contactless transactions.
plain_descriptions: smartphone app that stores payment details to pay for things online or in stores
electronic account holding stored balance or linked cards for contactless and online checkouts

label: Embedded system
summary: A dedicated computing assembly combining a microprocessor, firmware, and peripheral interfaces engineered to execute predefined control operations within an encompassing machine.
plain_descriptions: specialized computer built inside a larger machine to run dedicated tasks
compact microprocessor hardware dedicated entirely to single-purpose equipment control

label: Emergency fund
summary: A liquid cash reserve maintained specifically to absorb unforeseen expenses or income disruptions without taking on debt or liquidating long-term investments.
plain_descriptions: cash set aside to cover unexpected life emergencies without borrowing
safety net of three to six months of living expenses kept in a bank

label: Encryption
summary: The cryptographic process of encoding plaintext into ciphertext so that only authorized parties with the matching decryption key can read it.
plain_descriptions: scrambling secret information into unreadable code that only someone with the correct key can unlock
locking confidential data with a digital key so eavesdroppers see only scrambled nonsense

label: Environment variable
summary: A dynamic key-value pair stored in the operating system environment that configures program behavior without altering application source code.
plain_descriptions: a dynamic key-value setting stored outside software code to configure how it behaves in different environments
a configuration variable provided by the operating system to running programs

label: Equity
summary: The residual economic interest in an entity’s assets after deducting all of its liabilities.
plain_descriptions: value left for owners after paying off all business liabilities
total stake held by shareholders including contributed capital and accumulated profits

label: Exception
summary: An abnormal condition or error event encountered during execution that disrupts normal instruction flow and triggers specialized handling logic.
plain_descriptions: unexpected event or runtime failure that interrupts the normal sequence of instructions
error signaling mechanism that transfers control up the call stack to a recovery block

label: Exchange rate
summary: The comparative price of one national currency expressed in terms of another currency.
plain_descriptions: relative price tag determining how much foreign currency you get for one unit of domestic money
conversion value used when exchanging one nation’s currency for another

label: Firmware
summary: Low-level software programmed directly into non-volatile memory that provides operational instructions and hardware abstraction for electronic devices.
plain_descriptions: permanent low level software programmed directly into device non volatile storage
foundational code that instructs hardware components how to communicate and operate

label: Foreign key
summary: A column or set of columns in a relational database table that provides a link between data in two tables by referencing the primary key of another table.
plain_descriptions: a column in one table that points to the unique identifier of a row in another table
a database link ensuring an order cannot be created for a customer who does not exist

label: Function
summary: A self-contained block of instructions that accepts parameters, executes a computational routine, and optionally returns a result.
plain_descriptions: reusable block of code designed to perform a dedicated computation
packaged sequence of instructions that takes inputs and produces an output

label: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
summary: The total monetary or market value of all final goods and services produced within a country’s domestic borders over a specific timeframe.
plain_descriptions: total monetary value of all finished goods and services made within a country during a year
master scoreboard measuring the overall size and health of a nation’s economy

label: Branch
summary: A lightweight movable reference pointing to a specific commit within a Git repository that represents an independent timeline of development.
plain_descriptions: an independent line of work in a repository allowing safe experimentation
a movable pointer pointing to the latest commit in an isolated development path

label: Commit
summary: An immutable snapshot of staged changes recorded into Git repository history, associated with author metadata, timestamp, parent hashes, and a descriptive log message.
plain_descriptions: a saved snapshot recording the exact state of project files with an explanatory note
a permanent record in the repository history describing what was changed and who changed it

label: Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
summary: A specialized electronic processor optimized for high-throughput parallel execution of mathematical matrix operations essential for deep learning.
plain_descriptions: high-performance computer chips designed to handle massive parallel math for AI
the dedicated hardware processors that accelerate neural network training and inference

label: Hallucination
summary: Output from a generative model that sounds plausible but is false or unsupported, presented as if it were fact.
plain_descriptions: when the AI confidently makes things up
a made-up fact or fake citation from a chatbot

label: Hashtag
summary: A metadata tag prefixed by the pound or hash character used on social platforms and websites to categorize content and facilitate search.
plain_descriptions: a word or phrase beginning with a hash sign used to group topics
a clickable topic label on social networks that connects related posts

label: Headline
summary: The prominent heading positioned above a news article that encapsulates its core subject and catches the reader's attention.
plain_descriptions: the prominent title placed at the start of a news story
large text that tells readers what an article is about

label: Help desk
summary: A dedicated support service and software application designed to log, route, track, and resolve user technical problems and service requests.
plain_descriptions: support software that converts customer complaints into trackable tickets
central team and portal where employees or customers report technical glitches

label: High availability (HA)
summary: A system design characteristic ensuring operational performance and accessibility over extended periods by minimizing unplanned downtime through redundancy and fault tolerance.
plain_descriptions: building systems that stay online and accessible almost all the time without downtime
continuous service uptime achieved through redundant components and auto-recovery

label: Horizontal scaling
summary: The practice of increasing system capacity and handling greater load by adding more independent compute nodes or instances to a resource pool.
plain_descriptions: adding more machines or server instances to share workload
expanding capacity by running multiple copies of an application across a cluster

label: Human resource management system (HRMS)
summary: Software that automates personnel administration by maintaining worker records, attendance tracking, payroll, and benefits in one platform.
plain_descriptions: portal for employee contracts, leave requests, and payroll records
company software tracking hiring, attendance, and benefits

label: HTML
summary: The standard markup language used to structure documents and content displayed in web browsers.
plain_descriptions: the code tags that structure paragraphs, headings, and links on a webpage
the fundamental skeletal markup language of the web

label: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)
summary: A foundational client-server networking specification governing how web browsers fetch and submit hypermedia assets.
plain_descriptions: the communication rules that browsers and servers use to exchange web pages
the protocol delivering requests and responses across the World Wide Web

label: HTTP status code
summary: A standardized three-digit integer returned by a server indicating the outcome of a client’s HTTP request.
plain_descriptions: three-digit numbers that explain whether a web request succeeded or what went wrong
the server’s quick status signal like 404 not found or 200 ok

label: HTTPS
summary: An extension of HTTP that encrypts bidirectional communication using Transport Layer Security (TLS).
plain_descriptions: encrypted web browsing that protects information from snooping
the secure version of HTTP marked by the padlock in browsers

label: Incident
summary: An unplanned interruption, degradation, or disruption of an IT service that impairs business operations or user experience.
plain_descriptions: an unplanned event that breaks software or degrades service quality for users
a sudden technical emergency that requires immediate engineering intervention

label: Income statement
summary: A financial report illustrating a company’s operational revenues, expenses, and resultant net earnings over a specified period.
plain_descriptions: scorecard showing money earned and spent by a company over a duration
financial report demonstrating net profit or loss during a quarter or year

label: Inference
summary: The operational stage where a trained model processes live inputs to generate predictions, decisions, or outputs without updating its parameters.
plain_descriptions: running a trained AI model to get live answers or classifications
using an existing model on new inputs without changing its weights

label: Inflation
summary: A broad and sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services over time, eroding currency purchasing power.
plain_descriptions: general rise in prices across an economy that makes money lose purchasing power
situation where your cash buys fewer groceries and goods than it did previously

label: Insurance premium
summary: The recurring amount of money an individual or business pays to an insurance company to maintain an active insurance policy.
plain_descriptions: regular payment you make to an insurance company to keep your coverage active
monthly or annual price paid for an insurance policy protecting against risks

label: Interest Rate
summary: The proportion of an amount loaned which a lender charges as interest to the borrower, typically expressed as an annual percentage.
plain_descriptions: percentage fee charged for borrowing money
percentage reward earned on savings per year

label: Interpreter
summary: A computer program that directly executes instructions written in a programming or scripting language without requiring prior compilation into machine code.
plain_descriptions: program that reads, translates, and executes source code instructions on the fly without producing a binary file
execution engine that processes code line by line directly at runtime

label: JavaScript
summary: A dynamic multi-paradigm programming language featuring prototype inheritance that powers client-side web browser behavior.
plain_descriptions: the programming language that makes websites interactive and dynamic
the standard scripting engine running inside modern web browsers

label: JSON
summary: A lightweight, text-based data interchange format built on key-value pairs and ordered lists that is easy for humans to read and machines to parse.
plain_descriptions: a universal text format used to send data between websites and servers
human-readable curly-brace text organizing names and values in software

label: Kanban
summary: A visual workflow management method designed to optimize continuous flow, limit work in progress, and maximize efficiency.
plain_descriptions: visual project management board that tracks work across columns and limits tasks in progress
continuous delivery system focused on smoothing workflow and eliminating production bottlenecks

label: Key Performance Indicator (KPI)
summary: A quantifiable metric tracking ongoing operational efficacy and business performance against strategic benchmarks.
plain_descriptions: measurable target tracking whether a company or team is meeting its core operational goals
key business metric showing the ongoing performance and financial health of a product

label: Landing page
summary: A standalone web page created specifically for marketing campaigns where visitors arrive after clicking an ad, email, or promotional link.
plain_descriptions: the first web page you see right after clicking an advertisement
a dedicated page built to get visitors to take one specific action

label: Liability
summary: A present financial obligation of an enterprise arising from past events, settlement of which requires an outflow of economic resources.
plain_descriptions: financial debt or legal obligation owed by an individual or business to outside parties
money that must be paid back to lenders, vendors, or the government over time

label: Linter
summary: A static code analysis tool that inspects source code for programmatic errors, stylistic inconsistencies, security antipatterns, and non-standard syntax before runtime.
plain_descriptions: a tool that scans your code to find style errors, suspicious patterns, and potential bugs
an automated spell-checker for programming languages

label: Liquidity
summary: The operational ease and velocity with which an economic asset can be converted into spendable currency without suffering significant price erosion.
plain_descriptions: ease and speed with which an asset can be converted into ready cash without losing value
ability of an individual or company to pay off immediate debts on time

label: Large Language Model
summary: A very large neural network trained on huge amounts of text that reads and writes language by predicting the next token.
plain_descriptions: an AI that writes text by guessing the next word
the kind of chatbot brain behind ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude

label: localStorage
summary: A Web Storage API mechanism that allows web applications to store persistent key-value pairs locally within the user’s browser.
plain_descriptions: a storage compartment in your browser where websites save preferences permanently
key-value web storage that keeps information even after closing browser tabs

label: Log
summary: A timestamped, discrete record of an event or state change emitted by a running computer program or system service.
plain_descriptions: a timestamped text record written by software to explain what it just did
the running diary of events, errors, and actions that an application keeps

label: Low-code
summary: A software development approach combining graphical user interfaces and modular building blocks to construct digital solutions rapidly while accommodating hand-written programming extensions.
plain_descriptions: visual software development that lets developers build applications with minimal hand-coding
drag-and-drop programming platforms that speed up application delivery

label: Machine learning
summary: A branch of artificial intelligence where computer systems detect underlying patterns in data to improve task performance without static rule engines.
plain_descriptions: software that learns rules from examples instead of explicit programming
computer systems improving their accuracy automatically through experience

label: Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
summary: An authentication security method requiring users to supply two or more distinct evidence factors before granting access to a digital system.
plain_descriptions: logging in with two different proofs such as your password plus a code sent to your phone
a security checkpoint requiring a password and a fingerprint before opening an account

label: Microcontroller (MCU)
summary: A compact integrated circuit containing a processor core, memory, and programmable input/output peripherals designed for embedded control operations.
plain_descriptions: compact single chip computer designed to govern dedicated hardware tasks
integrated circuit containing a processor core memory and input output peripherals

label: Model
summary: A mathematical representation trained on data that captures patterns to generate predictions, decisions, or new content.
plain_descriptions: the trained software artifact that makes AI predictions
an algorithm packed with learned weights ready to run

label: Training
summary: The iterative computational process of calculating errors and adjusting model weights against training data to minimize loss.
plain_descriptions: the computational process of teaching an AI model using data
feeding examples into an algorithm so it can adjust its internal weights

label: Monolithic architecture
summary: An architectural model where all business capabilities, user interfaces, and database operations are packaged and deployed as a single combined system.
plain_descriptions: single software application built and deployed as a unified codebase
system where all features run inside one process and database

label: Minimum Viable Product (MVP)
summary: An early iteration of a product incorporating the minimum feature set necessary to validate foundational assumptions with real customers.
plain_descriptions: simplest early version of a product built with just enough features to test with real users
functional initial release designed to validate core business hypotheses with minimal engineering effort

label: Neural network
summary: A computational architecture comprising interconnected layers of artificial nodes that pass weighted signals through non-linear activation functions.
plain_descriptions: an AI computing structure inspired by interconnected biological brain cells
layered mathematical nodes passing signals forward to identify complex patterns

label: Newsletter
summary: A regularly distributed direct-to-inbox electronic publication focused on sharing news, curated insights, and company updates with an opted-in subscriber base.
plain_descriptions: a regularly sent email sharing news, articles, or updates with subscribers
an informative periodic email delivered directly to your inbox from a business or writer

label: Near-field communication (NFC)
summary: A short-range, high-frequency standards-based wireless connectivity technology operating at 13.56 MHz that enables intuitive two-way communication when devices are brought within 4 centimeters.
plain_descriptions: short-range wireless touch technology used for contactless payments and transit taps
close-contact wireless standard that transfers credentials when devices are tapped together

label: No-code
summary: A software creation method that empowers non-technical users to build functional applications and workflows entirely through graphical drag-and-drop interfaces without writing source code.
plain_descriptions: app building tools designed for non-technical users without writing any code
completely visual platforms where anyone can construct workflows and forms

label: NoSQL
summary: A broad class of non-relational database systems designed to handle flexible data models, high velocity, and horizontal scalability.
plain_descriptions: modern databases that store unstructured or changing data without rigid spreadsheet tables
flexible database systems designed to spread easily across hundreds of cloud servers

label: Null reference
summary: A pointer or reference value that signifies the absence of an object or points to an invalid address in memory.
plain_descriptions: pointer or variable that deliberately points to no valid memory address or object
unassigned reference state that triggers runtime crashes if dereferenced without checks

label: Object-oriented programming (OOP)
summary: A paradigm centered on modeling software as collections of cooperating objects that encapsulate state and behavior.
plain_descriptions: programming approach that structures code around self-contained objects holding data and behavior
software design philosophy based on modeling real world concepts as interacting entities

label: Objectives and Key Results (OKR)
summary: A collaborative goal-setting framework pairing ambitious qualitative objectives with measurable key results to track organizational progress.
plain_descriptions: goal-setting system that pairs an inspiring objective with measurable numerical results
quarterly framework aligning company direction, team focus, and quantifiable targets

label: Process
summary: An executing instance of a computer program allocated its own isolated memory address space and operating system resources.
plain_descriptions: running instance of a computer program with its own dedicated memory space
isolated execution environment managed by the operating system containing code, resources, and threads

label: Overfitting
summary: A modeling pathology where an algorithm learns idiosyncratic noise in training samples, severely impairing its ability to generalize to unseen data.
plain_descriptions: when an AI memorizes practice data so closely that it fails on fresh inputs
an AI model scoring near perfect in practice tests but failing real exams

label: Paywall
summary: A digital mechanism on online media websites restricting full access to premium articles and content behind paid subscriptions or memberships.
plain_descriptions: digital barrier restricting full access to online news articles to paying subscribers
a website system requiring a payment or membership before viewing restricted media content

label: Personal income tax
summary: A direct tax levied by governments on the wages, salaries, investment gains, and other financial earnings of individuals.
plain_descriptions: percentage of wages and earnings that an individual pays to the government
tax levied on personal salaries, dividends, and business profits each year

label: Podcast
summary: An episodic series of spoken-word digital audio files distributed over the internet that users can stream, download, and subscribe to automatically via feeds.
plain_descriptions: episodic digital audio program syndicated online for on-demand streaming and listening
spoken-word audio show subscribed to and played through streaming applications

label: Point of sale (POS)
summary: The combined hardware and software terminal where retail transactions are completed, payments processed, and inventory deducted.
plain_descriptions: the checkout terminal that rings up purchases and prints receipts
cash register hardware and software used at retail checkout counters

label: Press conference
summary: An organized event where an institution invites reporters to hear an announcement and ask questions on the record.
plain_descriptions: a media briefing where reporters ask questions directly to organizational representatives
an organized gathering where public figures deliver statements and take press queries

label: Press release
summary: A formal written communication distributed to news organizations to deliver official announcements and generate accurate news coverage.
plain_descriptions: an official written statement distributed by an organization to journalists
a prepared announcement presenting news from a company, government agency, or institution

label: Primary key
summary: A specific column or set of columns in a relational database table that uniquely identifies each individual record in that table.
plain_descriptions: a unique tag or number that tells one row apart from every other row in a database table
the unique identification column (like a national ID number) that ensures no duplicate records exist

label: Principal
summary: The original sum of money lent, invested, or borrowed before interest accrues.
plain_descriptions: original sum of money borrowed or invested
money before any interest gets calculated

label: Product backlog
summary: An evolving, ordered catalog of features, enhancements, and fixes representing the single source of work for a product team.
plain_descriptions: prioritized master list of features, bug fixes, and technical tasks waiting to be built
single authoritative repository of planned work for the entire software product team

label: Product owner (PO)
summary: The Scrum role accountable for maximizing product value and managing the prioritized content of the product backlog.
plain_descriptions: person responsible for deciding what features a product should have and setting their priority
key team member who connects user needs and business goals with development work

label: Product roadmap
summary: A strategic, evolving visual document mapping the vision, overarching direction, and planned milestones of a product over time.
plain_descriptions: high-level strategic timeline communicating where a product is heading and why
visual guide that aligns executives, developers, and customers on major product milestones

label: Prompt
summary: The text, and sometimes images or files, given to a language model as input to steer what it produces.
plain_descriptions: what you type to tell the AI what to do
the question or instructions you give a chatbot

label: Pull request (PR)
summary: A mechanism in distributed version control platforms that allows a developer to propose changes from a feature branch and request peer review before merging.
plain_descriptions: a formal request asking teammates to review and merge your branch into the main codebase
a shared discussion page displaying proposed code changes in version control

label: Python
summary: A high-level, general-purpose programming language characterized by readable syntax, dynamic typing, and comprehensive standard libraries.
plain_descriptions: high-level, dynamically typed programming language famous for readable syntax and indentation
versatile multi-paradigm language widely used for artificial intelligence, data analysis, and web services

label: Raspberry Pi
summary: A widely adopted series of compact, cost-effective ARM-based single-board computers equipped with a standard 40-pin header for peripheral interfacing and education.
plain_descriptions: popular series of small, affordable single-board computers for learning and prototyping
credit-card-sized computer board featuring 40 GPIO pins used widely in DIY and IoT builds

label: Recession
summary: A significant, widespread, and prolonged contraction in economic activity across an economy lasting more than a few months.
plain_descriptions: widespread economic decline where output shrinks, businesses struggle, and jobs are lost
prolonged period of falling national economic activity lasting across several months

label: Relational database
summary: A type of database that stores and provides access to data points that are related to one another through organized tables with predefined schemas.
plain_descriptions: a digital filing system that organizes facts into neat tables linked by common keys
structured database software that uses SQL to keep table records connected and strictly accurate

label: Responsive design
summary: An approach to web design that makes web pages render well on a variety of devices and screen window sizes.
plain_descriptions: designing web pages to adapt smoothly across phones, tablets, and desktop screens
flexible website styling that looks great on any screen resolution

label: REST
summary: An architectural style for network applications that uses standard HTTP methods to manipulate resources identified by URIs.
plain_descriptions: standard rules for how websites and apps exchange data over the web
the way modern apps talk to servers using standard web addresses

label: Revenue
summary: The total monetary intake realized by an enterprise through ordinary business activities before deducting operational costs and expenses.
plain_descriptions: total amount of money brought in through sales before subtracting any costs
top-line intake generated from delivering products and services to clients

label: Radio-frequency identification (RFID)
summary: A wireless identification technology employing electromagnetic radio frequency fields to automatically detect and read encoded data stored on passive or active electronic tags.
plain_descriptions: wireless technology using radio waves to identify and track tags attached to objects
electronic tagging system that scans toll transponders and inventory tags from meters away

label: Return on Investment
summary: A performance metric used to evaluate the efficiency or profitability of an investment relative to its cost.
plain_descriptions: how much money you make back compared to what you spent
performance metric measuring profitability of an expense

label: Lead
summary: An individual or organization that has expressed interest in a business's products or services and provided contact details for future communication.
plain_descriptions: a prospective customer who has shared contact information or shown interest in your product
someone who might buy from your business in the near future

label: Savings account
summary: An interest-bearing deposit account held at a bank or credit union that provides capital security, liquidity, and modest interest returns.
plain_descriptions: bank deposit account that pays interest while keeping your cash safe and accessible
place at a bank to store money for future goals rather than everyday spending

label: Scrum
summary: A lightweight process framework structured around transparency, inspection, and adaptation to build products incrementally.
plain_descriptions: collaborative framework for developing complex products in short timeboxed iterations
structured agile method featuring specific roles, backlogs, and iterative review meetings

label: Scrum master
summary: The Scrum role accountable for establishing Scrum practices, promoting team effectiveness, and removing operational impediments.
plain_descriptions: coach who guides the team in agile practices and removes blockers that slow down development
facilitator who protects engineers from external distractions and improves team collaboration

label: Software Development Kit (SDK)
summary: A comprehensive collection of development tools, client libraries, documentation, and code samples designed for creating applications on a specific platform or service.
plain_descriptions: an all-in-one toolbox for building software for a specific platform
a prepackaged set of tools and code libraries provided to developers

label: Semantic versioning
summary: A formal versioning specification utilizing a three-part numbering format (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) to communicate the compatibility nature of software changes.
plain_descriptions: a three-part version numbering system showing whether updates contain fixes, new features, or breaking changes
a standard release labeling scheme formatted as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH to signal compatibility

label: Sensor
summary: An input hardware component that senses physical attributes of the environment and converts them into measurable electrical signals.
plain_descriptions: electronic part that detects physical changes like temperature or motion
hardware module that converts real world signals into digital data

label: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
summary: The practice of improving a website's technical setup and content relevance so search engines rank its pages higher in unpaid results.
plain_descriptions: making a website appear higher on Google search results
getting free visitors to your web pages from search engines

label: Keyword
summary: A specific word or phrase entered into search engines that webmasters target to connect user search queries with relevant content.
plain_descriptions: the word or phrase someone types into Google when searching
the search term a web page targets to get ranked

label: Search Engine Results Page (SERP)
summary: The web page returned by a search engine in response to a user's search query, displaying organic listings, paid ads, and rich visual elements.
plain_descriptions: the list of web links Google shows after you search
the results screen displaying answers and links for your query

label: Simple Interest
summary: Interest calculated exclusively on the original principal amount for the entirety of the loan or deposit period.
plain_descriptions: interest calculated solely on the initial deposit
fixed interest payment that never compounds

label: Single point of failure (SPOF)
summary: A potential risk in system architecture where a single component failure will trigger the cessation of the entire system because no redundancy exists.
plain_descriptions: single part of a system whose failure stops the entire system from working
un-replicated component that can cause total system outage if it breaks

label: Smart home
summary: A residential environment equipped with interconnected electronic devices that automate domestic tasks, optimize utility usage, and enable centralized remote monitoring.
plain_descriptions: residence equipped with connected devices that automate lighting climate and security
networked household setup where appliances communicate and can be managed remotely

label: Smart meter
summary: An advanced electronic utility metering device that records consumption of electric energy, water, or gas in real time and communicates intervals back to the utility provider via automated networks.
plain_descriptions: digital utility meter that measures electricity, water, or gas and sends readings automatically
connected electric meter that reports consumption to the power company without manual meter readers

label: Container
summary: A standard unit of software packaging code and all runtime dependencies to execute reliably in isolation on a shared OS kernel.
plain_descriptions: a lightweight sandbox containing an app and its dependencies to run anywhere reliably
an isolated environment running software using shared operating system resources

label: Library
summary: A packaged collection of pre-written functions, classes, and subroutines that developers import and call directly to accomplish specific programmatic tasks.
plain_descriptions: a collection of reusable code routines that your program calls when needed
a package of pre-written functions you import to perform specific tasks

label: Sprint
summary: A timeboxed iteration of one month or less during which a team builds a functional, verified product increment.
plain_descriptions: fixed development timebox usually running two weeks to build working features
regular repeating cycle where a team converts selected backlog tasks into finished software

label: Sprint planning
summary: The collaborative event initiating each sprint where the Scrum team defines the sprint goal and forecasts backlog delivery.
plain_descriptions: collaborative meeting held at the start of a sprint to decide what work to tackle next
planning session where the team establishes a sprint goal and selects backlog items

label: Sprint retrospective
summary: The final event of a sprint where the Scrum team inspects its past performance regarding people, relationships, process, and tools to identify actionable improvements.
plain_descriptions: end-of-sprint team meeting to review what went well and identify concrete ways to improve
safe reflective space where teammates evaluate tools, processes, and interpersonal collaboration

label: Stakeholder
summary: An individual, team, or organization that can affect, be affected by, or perceive itself to be affected by a product decision or outcome.
plain_descriptions: anyone who has an interest in, influences, or is affected by the outcome of a product
key parties connected to a project, including end users, business leaders, investors, and regulatory bodies

label: Typography
summary: The art, craft, and technique of selecting and arranging typefaces, font weights, kerning, and spacing to render written language legible, readable, and visually engaging.
plain_descriptions: the craft of arranging fonts and text layout to make printed or digital words legible and appealing
artistic styling and formatting of letterforms across page and screen compositions

label: Web accessibility (a11y)
summary: The inclusive practice of ensuring there are no barriers that prevent interaction with websites by people with physical, sensory, or cognitive disabilities.
plain_descriptions: making websites usable for everyone, including people with visual or physical disabilities
building digital products that work seamlessly with assistive tools like screen readers

label: Wi-Fi
summary: A family of wireless network protocols based on the IEEE 802.11 standards used for local area networking of devices and high-speed internet access across licensed-exempt radio bands.
plain_descriptions: ubiquitous wireless radio technology that connects computers, phones, and IoT devices to the internet
high-speed wireless local area network standard operating over 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz bands
